C-SPLIT-SAVE-AUTHORITY.Architecture: The rich adapter is authoritative exactly when it is editable (not mirror), Standard rich or active editable Split permits it despite the retained sourceCode flag, and the unified source pane does not own focus. The existing source adapter keeps source focus authority. Keep captureDocumentSnapshot fail-closed for zero/multiple authorities and stale owners. Use the existing complete Muya model, source syntax, composition and correlated save machinery. No Source flag clearing, history redesign, utility/IPC/backend modification or save-UI change.

The new Source helper tests must exist and execute after implementation; the baseline measurement is not regression proof. Full coverage and browser/native startup belong to acceptance, not nested MustPassCommand gates.

Extend document-save-surfaces.test.js to mount the actual rich and source adapters and invoke captureDocumentSnapshot. The sourceCode=true, splitActive=true, unified focused=rich case must fail with unavailable on the baseline; retain the failure receipt.
